shared_elements: a row of repeated figures along the top
creatures/figures arranged facing sideways in a line
justification: Both surfaces organise profile-view relief figures into stacked registers separated by a ruled horizontal band, with a row of repeated small forms across the top zone, which is the most specific correspondence but also a very common compositional device. The depicted content otherwise diverges completely: A shows animals (quadrupeds, long-necked birds, serpentine and reptilian forms) with no human interaction, while B shows seated and standing human figures grouped around a laden offering table with columns of small sign-like marks.
